{{Top|leg}}
The '''pulse-gravity interdiction mine''' was a type of [[Space mine/Legends|space mine]] developed by the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]].

==Overview==
The mines where usually released from ships such as [[Hapan Battle Dragon]]s, which then flooded local space with an artificial [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]] into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The gravitational field of the mines caused [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to be ripped out of hyperspace, as well as to prevent ships in the immediate vicinity from jumping to hyperspace without first moving away from the mines. In this way, the mines functioned very much like an [[Interdiction field/Legends|interdiction field]], and were effective at waylaying most ships, providing that the mines weren't destroyed.<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

==History==
These interdictor mines were created by the [[Hapan]] people during the early stages of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Ebaq]], the weapons were provided to the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] for use against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="TUF" />
